name: google_analytics
description: Google Analytics GA4 page tracking. Injects gtag.js script when a valid Measurement ID is configured. Respects DNT (Do Not Track) headers.

params.description: Google Analytics 4 Measurement ID. Enables tracking when set.
params.effect: Injects gtag.js and initializes GA4 tracking on all pages

js.note: Loaded from Google CDN at runtime. No local file to override.

locked.reason: No local locked files. The CDN gtag.js is controlled by Google.

partials.note: Can replace entirely to use a different analytics provider (Plausible, Umami, etc.)
